what_happened.line: The Planning Board closed the public hearing on the 475 Leominster-Shirley Road warehouse after agreeing new wording for its traffic mitigation condition.
The board replaced the first half of the Phase Two mitigation bullet with proportional-impact language, leaving the form of contribution to the Planning Board and DPW director.
The final wording ties the contribution to the traffic increase over baseline in the 15 July 2021 GPI letter, applied to the 10 percent design cost estimate.
The board set an 80 percent occupancy threshold for the monitoring study, on the town traffic engineer's recommendation.
The board chose to pass over the water supply protection district and zoning map articles at Town Meeting and bring them back in spring.

why_it_matters: The condition fixes how much the warehouse developer pays toward the Fort Pond Road intersection, and any share it does not cover would fall to the town budget, which is mostly taxes.
The water supply protection district and zoning map changes will not be on this Town Meeting warrant, so voters will be asked to take them up in spring.
watch_next: The moderator is to be told that the two articles are passed over; the matter returns in spring.
The written decision on the 475 Leominster-Shirley Road warehouse, which should carry the final mitigation wording.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to recommend approval of all its warrant articles for the special town meeting, after closing the hearing on them.
The board approved the stormwater permit for 360 Flat Hill Road as revised, with set hours of operation and a replanting condition for the rain garden.
The board approved an ANR plan for 159/165 Mass Avenue and a de minimis change for Hannaford To Go, both by voice vote.
The board approved the scenic road tree-cutting permit for 360 Flat Hill Road and closed that hearing.
Hearings for 475 Leominster-Shirley Road and 101 Pleasant Street were continued to November 8; staff will draft decision language with sound wall conditions for the first.

why_it_matters: The zoning articles the board recommended are the ones residents will be asked to vote on at the special town meeting.

The 360 Flat Hill Road permits set operating hours and stormwater conditions that apply to a neighbouring site, and the 475 Leominster-Shirley Road sound wall conditions are still open until November 8.
watch_next: November 8 at 6:35 pm: continued hearings on 475 Leominster-Shirley Road (decision language with sound wall conditions) and 101 Pleasant Street.
The next Planning Board meeting: whether the board gives the bylaw review committee input on zoning bylaws.
